::: {.callout-warning}
**Under development - confirm everything in your own delivery.** This section
describes cost sources at the register level. Exact table and column names and
the available years **change from year to year** (the DRG rate system is updated
annually) and are not verified here. Use it as a pointer, and clarify the
specific files with your data manager.
:::

To compute **healthcare use/costs** per person, they are typically assembled
from several sources:

- **Somatic hospital contacts:** DRG-grouped data from the Danish Health Data
  Authority (SDS). Rates express average operating expenses per DRG group and
  are computed annually - see [SDS DRG
  rates](https://sundhedsdatastyrelsen.dk/data-og-registre/sundhedsoekonomi/drg/drg-takster).
  In the LPR2 period, inpatients were grouped by DRG and outpatients by DAGS
  (Dansk Ambulant Grupperings System) ([SDS, DRG-grouped
  LPR](https://www.esundhed.dk/Dokumentation/DocumentationExtended?id=12)).
  Today all somatic patients are settled with DRG tariffs ([Takstvejledning
  2024](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/media/15344/Takstvejledning_2024.pdf),
  chapter 3). Which files DST holds is in [DRG data at DST](#drg-at-dst).
- **Psychiatric hospital contacts:** are **not** billed by DRG. Inpatients are
  settled with a bed-day rate and outpatient visits with a visit rate, and
  "Frem til takstsystem 2018 blev der beregnet vejledende DRG- og DAGS-takster
  for psykiatrien" ([Takstvejledning
  2024](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/media/15344/Takstvejledning_2024.pdf),
  section 3.2). Keep somatic and psychiatric separate.
- **Primary sector** (general practice, specialists etc.): fees in `sysi`/`sssy`
  ([Overview of registers](register-reference.qmd#sysi-sssy)).
- **Medication:** patient co-payment vs. reimbursement in
  [LMDB](register-reference.qmd#lmdb).

## DRG data at DST {#drg-at-dst}

<!-- TODO(Sara): wording for the lead-in to this table -->
DST holds the DRG-grouped data as separate registers for each period ([DST's
register
overview](https://www.dst.dk/extranet/ForskningVariabellister/Oversigt%20over%20registre.html)):

  | Register                                                 | Content                                         | Years                        | Status                   |
  | -------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------ |
  | `DRGSOMA_HEL`, `DRGSOMA_AMB`                             | LPR2, inpatients and outpatients                | 2002-2017                    | Closed 15 January 2024   |
  | `DRGSOMA_KONTAKT`, `DRGSOMA_SGHFORLOB`, `DRGSOMA_PROCEDURE` | Contacts, hospital courses and procedures     | 2018                         | Closed 15 January 2024   |
  | `DRGPSYK_HEL`, `DRGPSYK_AMB`                             | Indicative psychiatric tariffs                  | 2004-2018                    | Closed 15 January 2024   |
  | `DRG_KONTAKTER`, `DRG_SGHFORLOB`                         | LPR3, contacts and hospital courses             | Tariff years 2021-2025       | Updated yearly           |
  | `DRG_DIAGNOSE`, `DRG_PROCEDURE` and three more            | LPR3, diagnoses, procedures and internal codes  | Tariff years 2022-2025       | Updated yearly           |

## The year of an LPR3 DRG file is the tariff year {#drg-tariff-year}

In `DRG_KONTAKTER` and `DRG_SGHFORLOB` the year in the file name is the tariff
year, not the year the activity took place. DST: "DRG tabellerne for de
forskellige takstår indeholder information om kontakter (aktiviteter) for det
pågældende og de to foregående aktivitetsår, jf. variablen AKTIVITETSAAR"
([DST, register note for
DRG_KONTAKTER](https://www.dst.dk/extranet/ForskningVariabellister/Bemaerkning/DRG_KONTAKTER%20-%20Landspatientregistret%20(LPR3)%20takster%20%E2%80%93%20DRG%20kontakter.html)).
The first release grouped tariff system 2021 with activity years 2019 to 2021
and tariff system 2022 with 2020 to 2022 ([DST, register history for
DRG_KONTAKTER](https://www.dst.dk/extranet/ForskningVariabellister/Registerhistorik/DRG_KONTAKTER.html),
14 May 2024).

- **Do not stack the yearly files.** Most activity is in three files, each
  time priced with a different tariff system. Choose rows by `AKTIVITETSAAR`.
- **Activity in 2019 and 2020** is only in the files for tariff years 2021 and
  2022, so it is priced with those tariffs.
- **Prices compare within one tariff system.** SDS: tariffs hold for one
  calendar year, "men i uddata grupperes typisk flere aktivitetsår, så årene
  kan sammenlignes i samme takstsystem" ([SDS, DRG-grouped LPR3 data, tariff
  system
  2025](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/Media/638769532677303948/DRG-grupperet%20LPR3-data%20-%20Takstsystem%202025%20-%20Dokumentation.pdf),
  section 6.3). `AKTIVITETSAAR` is the year the last contact of the hospital
  course ended (same source, section 3).

## Contact or hospital course: price one level {#drg-price-level}

Both levels carry a price: `PRIS_DRG` is the tariff of the contact's DRG group
and `PRIS_DRG_DRGSGHF` the tariff of the hospital course's DRG group, and
`TOTALPRIS_*` adds the long-stay price at each level ([SDS, tariff system
2025](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/Media/638769532677303948/DRG-grupperet%20LPR3-data%20-%20Takstsystem%202025%20-%20Dokumentation.pdf),
Tabel 25). Settlement happens "pr. DRG-sygehusforløb" ([Takstvejledning
2026](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/Media/639014923392486672/Takstsystem%202026.pdf),
section 3.1.1). Summing contact and course prices counts the same activity
twice.

## What a DRG price covers {#drg-price-covers}

"Taksterne afspejler de beregnede, direkte udgifter til behandling af
patienten og til udførelse af genoptræningsydelser. Der er således ikke
inkluderet udgifter til eksempelvis tjenestemandspension, forrentning og
afskrivning" ([Takstvejledning
2024](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/media/15344/Takstvejledning_2024.pdf),
chapter 3). Some services are settled separately at cost, such as SYD02,
"Udleveret medicin til patienter for mere end 1.000 kr. pr. dag"
([Takstvejledning
2026](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/Media/639014923392486672/Takstsystem%202026.pdf),
Bilagstabel 7). Medicine treatment at the hospital is itself grouped and
priced in DRG, for example in the groups 34PR01 to 34PR10 "Medicin-behandling"
(same source, Bilag B3.2), so adding costs from the [Hospital Medication
Register](hospital-medication.qmd) on top of DRG prices can count it twice.

## The LPR2 period and 2019 {#drg-lpr2}

- In `DRGSOMA_HEL` and `DRGSOMA_AMB`, `V_PRIS` is "Angivet i 1.000 kr.", and
  for inpatients `V_AAR` is "Året for udskrivningsdatoen i den sidste kontakt
  i forløbet", so costs follow the discharge year ([SDS, DRG-grouped
  LPR](https://www.esundhed.dk/Dokumentation/DocumentationExtended?id=12)).
- A stay that crossed the change to LPR3 in 2019 is priced on its LPR3 course.
  Its LPR2 course gets the group 90UA07 "Flyttet til DRG LPR3" ([SDS,
  DRG-grouped LPR3 data, tariff system
  2019](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/media/15120/DRG_grupperet_LPR3_data_2019.pdf),
  section 3.4.3.3).

<!-- TODO(Sara): wording, and whether this closing paragraph stays -->
Availability of cost data varies between projects and years. The pattern is
inspired by [the Plana-Ripoll group's code on OSF](https://osf.io/zhfyp/overview),
but the variable names there are from a 2022 delivery and should not be
assumed current.
